purpose: Broad candidate list for translation/OCR/QA-stage benchmarking (scripts/benchmark_translation.py, benchmark_vlm_ocr.py, benchmark_qa.py). Wider net than config/providers.json's curated production model lists — includes models not yet vetted for the fallback chain. This is a refresh of the 2026-08-06 pull (see docs/free_model_bench_plan_2026-08.md §1) that (a) adds qaLLM/qaVLM lists to every provider per that plan's explicit rule (qaLLM := tl list, qaVLM := ocr list — same underlying models under a different task key), and (b) re-verifies free-tier membership live rather than trusting the prior snapshot, since free tiers churn: OpenRouter's free chat-model count moved from 14 to 17 with different composition (ling-3.0-flash:free left the free tier entirely, replaced by ling-3.0-tiny:free), Cloudflare's API now surfaces real USD-equivalent neuron pricing per model and reveals 3 models gated behind Workers Paid that config/providers.json currently mismarks as free, and NVIDIA NIM dropped 3 models (deepseek-v4-flash/pro, mistral-medium-3.5-128b) from its catalog. openrouter queried from GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (400 total, 17 pricing.prompt==0); cloudflare from GET .../ai/models/search (61 Text Generation + Image-to-Text models); nvidia from GET https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models (99 total) cross-checked against the 2026-08-06 manually-curated list — all three pulled live 2026-08-07. Embeddings, reranking, safety/moderation classifiers, image/audio generation, ASR/TTS, and document-parsing-only models excluded throughout. This pass also adds 4 cheap PAID OpenRouter models (free:false) for baseline comparison — the ones already wired as production defaults in config/providers.json (qwen/qwen3.7-flash, qwen/qwen3-vl-32b-instruct, deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite) — so the free tier's ranking can be read against a 'what we actually pay for today' baseline, not just against itself. Not yet benchmarked — do not treat 'free' here as a quality or reliability signal, only as 'no listed cost' (or, for Cloudflare, 'covered by the shared 10,000 neurons/day allowance').

cloudflare.notes: 10,000 Neurons/day free allowance is shared across ALL Cloudflare Workers AI usage on the account, not per-model (confirmed via developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/, 2026-08-07). 3 models in this catalog declare require_workers_paid=true and are NOT reachable on that free allowance regardless of neuron balance (kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.7-code, glm-5.2) — all three are marked free:true in the production config/providers.json today, which is wrong as of this pull. Run OCR/qaVLM sweeps on their own day per docs/free_model_bench_plan_2026-08.md §3 since vision payloads burn neurons faster than text.
